GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-09-13T23:20:07Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: replay does not cache if subscribed to using toBlocking().toFuture().get()
Description: Given the following snippet:

```
    BehaviorSubject<Observable<Integer>> s = BehaviorSubject.create(Observable.just(1));

    Observable<Integer> o = s.flatMap(sp -> sp).replay(1).autoConnect();

    //o.subscribe();

    System.out.println("1st = " + o.first().toBlocking().toFuture().get(0, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

    s.onNext(Observable.just(2));

    System.out.println("2st = " + o.first().toBlocking().toFuture().get(0, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
```

I expect output: 

```
1st = 1
2nd = 2 
```

instead I get 

```
1st = 1 
2nd = 1
```

If I uncomment o.subscribe(), then the replay value gets updated correctly on 2nd.  Also it works correctly if not using the flatMap().
